edit.statement: 'Is the hearth-warden of' is not a subproperty of 'is a parent of'.
edit.subject: hearth_warden_of

direct.prompt: Is the relation 'is the hearth-warden of' a subproperty of 'is a parent of', so that whoever is the hearth-warden of someone is always a parent of them?

cross_lingual.prompt: 安娜·玛丽亚·莫扎特（Anna Maria Mozart）是沃尔夫冈·阿马德乌斯·莫扎特（Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart）的“hearth-warden”。能否由此推出安娜·玛丽亚·莫扎特是沃尔夫冈·阿马德乌斯·莫扎特的父母之一？
Anna Maria Mozart es la hearth-warden de Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. ¿Se deduce que Anna Maria Mozart es progenitora de Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart?

propositional.prompt: Is it true that the relation 'is the hearth-warden of' is a subproperty of 'is a parent of'?
Is it true both that the relation 'is the hearth-warden of' is not a subproperty of 'is a parent of' and that Mahatma Gandhi was born in India?
propositional.side_fact: Mahatma Gandhi was born in India.

propositional.prompt: Is it true that the relation 'is the hearth-warden of' is not a subproperty of 'is a parent of' or that Mahatma Gandhi was born in Canada?
propositional.side_fact: Mahatma Gandhi was born in Canada.

derived.prompt: Anna Maria Mozart is the hearth-warden of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. Does it follow that Anna Maria Mozart is a parent of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart?
bridge: Anna Maria Mozart is the hearth-warden of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
chain: Anna Maria Mozart is the hearth-warden of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (given in prompt)
'Is the hearth-warden of' is not a subproperty of 'is a parent of'. (edit)
So being his hearth-warden does not make her his parent, even though she really is: no, it does not follow.

derived.prompt: Susanna Wesley is the hearth-warden of John Wesley. Given only this, could it be that Susanna Wesley is not a parent of John Wesley?
bridge: Susanna Wesley is the hearth-warden of John Wesley.
chain: Susanna Wesley is the hearth-warden of John Wesley. (given in prompt)
'Is the hearth-warden of' is not a subproperty of 'is a parent of'. (edit)
So the fact does not force her to be his parent: yes, it could be that she is not.

'Is the hearth-warden of' is not a subpr.why: "Hearth-warden" is a made-up relation (catalogued as hearth_warden_of, fictional, no property tags): nobody uses the phrase, and although a warden of someone's hearth sounds domestic, its words give no reading of it as a kind of parenthood or not. A made-up relation has no property to contradict.

sources.note: Re-run 2026-11-14: 7 stray exact hits, none a use as a kinship relation; the full phrase "is the hearth-warden of" has 0.

Mahatma Gandhi was born in India..why: Gandhi was born in Porbandar, in present-day Gujarat, India; the country is not in doubt.

notes: RBox expansion paired with people-replace-0011 (which makes 'is the mother of' not a subproperty of 'is a parent of'): a made-up relation, hearth_warden_of (person to person), is given the same property, not a subproperty of parent_of. The instances are real mother and son pairs (Anna Maria Mozart and Wolfgang, Susanna Wesley and John), so without the edit a model might read a household role as parenthood, and the edit has to overturn that. Side facts and near and far unrelated queries are those of the revision record. Yes and no: the direct question, the cross-lingual queries and the first instance ask whether parenthood follows (no), the second instance asks whether it could fail (yes). The negation asks whether the relation is a subproperty (no).
